They are appended to the visible reply later by _compose_staged_cue in storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py (~line 1415) and by the engine's own cue path in _complete_accepted_turn (~line 318-350). If the target is found/established during the very turn that shows the cue, or a handoff/scene change happens, a stale cue ('you still need to find X') can be displayed. Today only a prior-turn check exists.

GOAL: (1) Add a single story-agnostic helper that answers 'is this staged cue still eligible against the FINAL projected state of this turn' (target fact not already true, cue_reveal_available still true, delivery.scene_id equals the current scene, not already retired by a delivered stage-2) and call it immediately before the cue segment is assembled into visible output on EVERY path that shows a cue or escalation (engine and cloudflare). A cue that fails is omitted and the staged fields cleared (staged_cue_fact_id None, stage 1) so it cannot reappear; completion/cancellation must be idempotent and survive save/load (state snapshot round-trip). (2) Also re-check queued escalation text and handoff-staged text the same way if such a path exists; report in notes which paths you found and covered.

ACCEPTANCE TESTS (write FIRST, confirm at least the same-turn ones fail before the fix, then pass): new file tests/test_cue_lifecycle.py, on the real package (use journey helpers as tests/test_discovery_continuity.py and tests/test_staged_cues.py do) AND on a small unrelated synthetic package or the lighthouse fixture for the story-agnostic case. Sequences: find -> inspect -> move -> save/load -> revisit shows no cue for the found target; find via an alternative realization; find and leave the scene on the same turn; acquire then drop the item (discovery cue stays retired); a rejected discovery (uncommitted model-only claim) keeps the cue alive; a deadline coinciding with acquisition; duplicate delivery of the same event is not repeated. Assert on visible response segments and state, never on prose search for item names. Update an existing test only if it pinned the old behavior and say so in the notes.

Ruff on files you touch: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <files>, then -m ruff format <files>. Do not run uv.
